parakeet: Bottom line, the word God has lost all coherent meaning. Until it's defined in testable terms, it's not a useful or defendable claim. I don't say there is no God lightly or for shock value. I say it because it's the most honest, most defensible position when we step back and examine the actual roots of the idea, not just the claim, but the entire scaffolding that keeps it standing in human society.
